  WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-08-17' AND '2026-10-02'
  GROUP BY c.country, o.order_date
)
SELECT k.country,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM days) AS n_days,
  SUM(IFNULL(dy.rev, 0)) AS total_rev,
  SUM(IFNULL(dy.rev, 0)) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM days) AS avg_daily_rev,
  COUNTIF(dy.rev IS NOT NULL) AS days_with_orders
FROM countries k
CROSS JOIN days d
LEFT JOIN daily dy ON dy.country = k.country AND dy.order_date = d.order_date
GROUP BY k.country
ORDER BY avg_daily_rev ASC
